factorConstruction: basket = affinity-weighted blend of the non-holding entities Qloo recommends from the resolved entities of each sub-sector's audience (brand, movie, artist, tv_show; every name in the universe excluded by construction), each member's weekly taste return = ln(velocity_fold_change) from Qloo /v2/trending, averaged within a week; regression per name: weekly return ~ SPY return + sector basket return over 106 aligned weeks. One factor, 101 names, so the call count grows with sectors rather than with the book. Featured names additionally carry an audience-level basket built from their own entity. The same estimator is re-run unchanged on the 106 weekly returns immediately before that window.

flagRule.method: negative beta, |t| >= 2, Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.1 across priced names

valueAdd.note: mean in-sample gain in r² from adding the taste basket to the market regression, in percentage points

ablation.note: ablation control: a same-sector peer basket — the equal-weight return of the other names in the sub-sector, from the same committed prices — fitted before the taste basket. In-sample tasteExtraR2 cannot fall when a regressor is added, so the headline is the out-of-sample arm: peer-only vs peer+taste, fitted on the first 70 weeks and scored on the last 36

sentiment.note: consumer-sentiment exclusion: the taste basket must add over SPY *and* the University of Michigan Index of Consumer Sentiment (FRED UMCSENT). The index is monthly, carried as its month-over-month change on the weeks inside that month — coarse by construction, not interpolated to a weekly series it does not have; a weekly sentiment series would be the stronger control.

oos.note: same nested comparison, fitted on the first 70 weeks and scored on the last 36; not clamped

placebo.note: book mean ΔR² against 400 circular rotations of the taste baskets, all names shifted together; p is the share of rotations that match or beat the real alignment

secondary.note: pre-registered replication: the same estimator and threshold on the 106 weekly returns immediately before the primary window, fixed in config/book.json before the keyed run
